questions.stem: Which of the following is a macromolecule found in living systems?
questions.solution: Proteins are macromolecules made up of amino acids. Fatty acids and amino acids are small molecules, while nucleotides are building blocks of nucleic acids, not macromolecules themselves.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन जीवित प्रणालियों में पाया जाने वाला एक मैक्रोमॉलिक्यूल है?
hi.solution: प्रोटीन एमिनो अम्लों से बने मैक्रोमॉलिक्यूल होते हैं। वसा अम्ल और एमिनो अम्ल छोटे अणु होते हैं, जबकि न्यूक्लियोटाइड न्यूक्लिक अम्लों के निर्माण के ब्लॉक होते हैं, न कि मैक्रोमॉलिक्यूल खुद।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard Hindi scientific terminology.

mr.solution: प्रोटीन अमीनो अम्लांनी बनलेले मॅक्रोमॉलेक्यूल आहेत. तृतीयक अम्ल आणि अमीनो अम्ल लहान अणू आहेत, तर न्यूक्लिओटाइड हे न्यूक्लिक अम्लांचे बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक आहेत, मॅक्रोमॉलेक्यूल नाहीत.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a heteropolymer?
questions.solution: Proteins are heteropolymers because they are composed of different types of amino acids linked together. Starch, cellulose, and glycogen are homopolymers made up of only glucose molecules. The structure of proteins involves a diverse sequence of building blocks, unlike the uniform structure of the other options.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक हेटेरोपॉलीमर है?
hi.solution: प्रोटीन हेटेरोपॉलीमर होते हैं क्योंकि वे विभिन्न प्रकार के एमिनो एसिड से बने होते हैं। स्टार्च, सेलूलोज और ग्लाइकोजन केवल ग्लूकोज अणुओं से बने होमोपॉलीमर होते हैं। प्रोटीन की संरचना में बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक्स की विविध अनुक्रम होता है, जबकि अन्य विकल्पों की संरचना एकसमान होती है।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate, technical terms are correctly used in Hindi as per standard textbooks.

mr.solution: प्रोटीन हेटेरोपॉलिमर आहेत कारण ते विविध प्रकारच्या अमिनो अम्लांनी जोडलेले असतात. स्टार्च, सेल्युलोज आणि ग्लायकोजन हे फक्त ग्लूकोज अणूंनी बनलेले होमोपॉलिमर आहेत. प्रोटीनची संरचना इतर पर्यायांच्या एकरूप संरचनेपेक्षा विविध बांधकामाच्या क्रमात असते.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a characteristic of amino acids?
choices: They all have the same R group
They contain only a single functional group
They contain both an amino group and a carboxyl group
They are the simplest form of carbohydrates
questions.solution: Amino acids are organic compounds that contain both an amino group and a carboxyl group attached to the same carbon atom, known as the α-carbon. This is a defining characteristic. The first option is incorrect because the R group varies among different amino acids. The second option is wrong because amino acids have multiple functional groups. The last option is false because amino acids are essential components of living organisms.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of an enzyme that catalyses the transfer of a group between two substrates?
questions.solution: Transferases are enzymes that specifically catalyze the transfer of a chemical group from one molecule to another. Oxidoreductases are involved in electron transfer reactions, hydrolases break bonds by adding water, and isomerases rearrange the structure of a molecule without transferring groups. Therefore, transferases are the correct choice.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक ऐसा एंजाइम है जो दो उपासमग्रों के बीच एक समूह के स्थानांतरण को उत्प्रेरित करता है?

questions.stem: Which of the following is a nucleotide?
questions.solution: Adenylic acid is a nucleotide because it contains a phosphate group attached to a sugar, which is a key feature of nucleotides. Adenine and uracil are nitrogenous bases, not complete nucleotides. Adenosine is a nucleoside, which lacks the phosphate group found in nucleotides.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक न्यूक्लियोटाइड है?

questions.stem: What happens to the structure of an amino acid when placed in a solution of different pH?
questions.solution: When an amino acid is placed in a solution of different pH, it can form a zwitterion, which is a molecule with both positive and negative charges. This happens due to the ionization of the amino and carboxyl groups. The first option is incorrect because the structure does change. The third and fourth options are false because amino acids do not lose their functional groups or turn into carbohydrates.

questions.stem: If a competitive inhibitor is added to an enzyme reaction, what is the most likely outcome?
questions.solution: Competitive inhibitors bind to the active site of the enzyme, preventing the substrate from binding, which reduces the reaction rate. Permanent inactivation and denaturation are not typical outcomes of competitive inhibition, as the inhibitor does not alter the enzyme's structure irreversibly. Increased product formation would not occur because the inhibitor blocks the reaction pathway.

questions.stem: If a protein is denatured, which of the following is most likely to happen?
choices: It will lose its three-dimensional structure
It will become a different type of protein
It will start functioning as a different enzyme
questions.solution: Denaturation refers to the disruption of a protein's three-dimensional structure, which is critical for its proper function. This structural change typically leads to loss of function, but not necessarily to becoming a different type of protein or a more stable one. The other options do not align with the fundamental definition of denaturation.

hi.stem: यदि एक प्रोटीन अनुच्छेदित हो जाता है, तो निम्नलिखित में से क्या सबसे अधिक संभावना है?

hi.solution: अनुच्छेदन का अर्थ है प्रोटीन की त्रिआयामी संरचना के विघटन के लिए, जो इसके सही कार्य के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है। यह संरचनात्मक परिवर्तन आमतौर पर कार्य के नुकसान के कारण होता है, लेकिन आवश्यक रूप से एक अलग प्रकार के प्रोटीन या अधिक स्थिर होने के कारण नहीं होता है। अन्य विकल्प अनुच्छेदन की मूल अवधारणा के साथ मेल नहीं खाते हैं।

questions.stem: Which of the following is a function of proteins?
questions.solution: Proteins carry out many functions, including the transport of nutrients across the cell membrane. Energy storage is a function of carbohydrates, cellulose formation is a function of polysaccharides, and DNA replication is a function of nucleic acids.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा प्रोटीन का कार्य है?
hi.solution: प्रोटीन विभिन्न कार्य करते हैं, जिनमें कोशिका झिल्ली के पार पोषक तत्वों का परिवहन शामिल है। ऊर्जा संग्रहण कार्बोहाइड्रेट का कार्य है, सेलुलोज़ का निर्माण पॉलीसैकराइड का कार्य है और डीएनए प्रतिकृति न्यूक्लिक अम्ल का कार्य है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate scientific terminology as used in Hindi textbooks.

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the most suitable for a thermophilic organism's enzyme?
questions.solution: Thermophilic organisms thrive in high-temperature environments, so their enzymes are adapted to function optimally at elevated temperatures. An enzyme that works best at 80°C is most suitable because it matches the optimal temperature range for such organisms. Enzymes that work best at lower temperatures, like 25°C or 40°C, would not function effectively in these extreme conditions, and an enzyme that works best at 100°C would likely denature or lose function at that temperature.

questions.stem: If an enzyme is exposed to a temperature above its optimum, what is the most likely effect on the reaction?
questions.solution: Enzymes are proteins, and high temperatures can cause them to lose their specific three-dimensional shape, which is essential for their function. This process, called denaturation, typically results in the enzyme becoming permanently inactive. The other options are incorrect because reaction rates do not increase with excessive heat, and the enzyme's structure is not maintained under such conditions.

questions.stem: If a competitive inhibitor is structurally similar to a substrate, which of the following is most likely to happen?
choices: The inhibitor will bind to the active site and prevent the substrate from binding
The inhibitor will bind to a different site and change the enzyme's shape
The inhibitor will increase the reaction rate
The inhibitor will denature the enzyme
questions.solution: A competitive inhibitor, being structurally similar to the substrate, can bind to the active site of the enzyme, blocking the substrate from doing so. This directly interferes with the enzyme's ability to catalyze the reaction. The other options describe effects of non-competitive inhibition, enzyme activation, or structural damage, which do not apply to competitive inhibitors.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about the quaternary structure of a protein?
choices: It refers to the sequence of amino acids
It refers to the three-dimensional structure
It refers to the arrangement of subunits
It refers to the folding of a single polypeptide chain
questions.solution: The quaternary structure refers to how the individual subunits of a protein are arranged with respect to each other. The primary structure is the sequence of amino acids, the secondary and tertiary structures refer to the folding of a single polypeptide chain, and the quaternary structure involves multiple subunits.

choices: इसका अर्थ एमिनो एसिड के क्रम से होता है
इसका अर्थ त्रिआयामी संरचना से होता है
इसका अर्थ उपइकाइयों की व्यवस्था से होता है
इसका अर्थ एकल पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखला के मोड़ने से होता है
hi.solution: चतुर्थक संरचना एक प्रोटीन की व्यक्तिगत उपइकाइयों के एक दूसरे के सापेक्ष व्यवस्था के बारे में होती है। प्राथमिक संरचना एमिनो एसिड के क्रम के बारे में होती है, द्वितीयक एवं तृतीयक संरचना एकल पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखला के मोड़ने के बारे में होती है, एवं चतुर्थक संरचना में कई उपइकाइयाँ शामिल होती हैं।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the scientific terminology used in Hindi textbooks.

mr.solution: चतुर्थ रचना ही प्रोटीनच्या विशिष्ट सबयुनिट्सच्या एकमेकांशी असलेल्या व्यवस्थित व्यवस्थेचा अर्थ आहे. प्राथमिक रचना ही अमीनो अम्लांचा क्रम आहे, द्वितीय आणि तृतीय रचना ही एका पॉलिपेप्टाइड शृंखलेचे फोल्डिंग आहे, आणि चतुर्थ रचना बहुसबयुनिट्सच्या संबंधात असते.
